purpose: Recorded single-axis vibration change-detection feasibility pilot
scope: Stitched physical fan recordings, not measured physical transitions, faults, independent devices or hardware energy

dataset.timestamps: Nominal times inferred from source collection description; CSV contains no measured timestamps

input.feature: sqrt(mean(x*x)) over disjoint complete windows; emit at window end
input.normalization_fit: All config1 training-prefix RMS features only

split.range_convention: Zero-based half-open; no fitting on held-speed recordings
split.training_order: Listed training speeds, separate sessions retaining learned weights

streams.quarter_rule: For each block index j, take its listed configuration at the stream's held speed, raw rows [750*q,750*(q+1)) where q=positive_quarters[j]; every held-speed source group is wholly excluded from training and calibration
streams.sham_quarter_rule: Each sham_orders row is the four source quarter indices; same raw range convention, configuration1 and that stream's held speed throughout
streams.speed_rule: All blocks in a stream share one held speed
streams.event_meaning: First wholly post-join feature index, zero-based
streams.source_dependence: Two positive and two sham streams per held speed reuse recording material; neither clips nor seeds are independent recordings
streams.state_rule: Fresh copy of that arm's trained snapshot for each stream; retain temporal state and parameter updates across joins; reset only at stream boundaries
streams.warmup_rule: Indices0..4 process actual inputs and any pending prediction updates normally but emit no scored alarm; index0 has no previous forecast. Index5 first compares its value with the forecast emitted at index4. Apply identically to calibration and test

neural.initialization: random.Random(seed); for each unit draw uniform(-0.05,0.05) for weight then uniform(-0.02,0.02) for bias; add to repeating base templates; readout weights alternate -0.05,+0.05; output bias zero
neural.spike_and_reset: s=1[u>=1]; m=u-s; one spike maximum per sample
neural.continuous: s=tanh(u); m=u; derivative 1-tanh(u)^2 and no reset derivative
neural.eligibility: e_u=a*e_m+(1-a)*input; LIF e_s=surrogate*e_u, e_m=e_u-e_s; ANN e_s=(1-tanh(u)^2)*e_u,e_m=e_u; e_r=q*e_r+(1-q)*e_s; bias input is1
neural.credit: At next actual measurement, use saved prediction, rates, eligibility and PRE-update readout; output_delta=(prediction-target)*prediction*(1-prediction); update readout and input weights together; online local surrogate, not full-network BPTT
neural.frozen_arm: Copy plastic_snn trained parameters, disable all parameter learning during calibration and test
neural.readout_arm: Same initialization and dynamics, incoming weights fixed throughout; readout learns

baselines.persistence: Predict next feature equal to current feature
baselines.ema: Predict next feature with EMA, a=exp(-dt/5); initialize at first value
baselines.nlms: AR(2)+bias features f=[last_value,previous_value,1]; initial weights [1,0,0]; missing previous_value=last_value; prediction=clip(dot(weights,f),0,1); when target arrives compute all delta_i=clip(0.05*(target-saved_prediction)*saved_f_i/(0.001+sum(saved_f^2)),-0.01,0.01), then weights_i=clip(weights_i+delta_i,-2,2); update only after target arrives

calibration.state: Separate fresh trained copy per calibration recording, with the same learning flags as that test arm; discard calibration updates
calibration.selection: One predetermined operating point; no threshold sweep or selection on test outcomes

detector.alarm: score > calibrated_threshold AND at least 5 window indices since previous alarm
detector.matching: At most one alarm per event in [event_index,event_index+5); remaining alarms are false positives
detector.delay: Alarm window end time minus join time; minimum 0.2 seconds
detector.timing: Emit/record score and alarm BEFORE updating predictor with actual value
detector.labels: Evaluator only after predictions and alarms; never affect online updates

primary: sham false alarms per stable minute
secondary: false alarms on positive stable intervals
evaluation.aggregation: Report each held speed, order and model seed; pooled counts are descriptive correlated repetitions
evaluation.practical_gate: For every seed, plastic_snn recall>=0.8 and sham_false_alarms_per_minute<=1
evaluation.adaptation_gate: Practical gate AND for every seed plastic_snn recall>=frozen_snn recall+0.10 with no higher sham false-alarm rate
evaluation.snn_specific_gate: Practical gate AND for every seed plastic_snn recall>=plastic_ann recall+0.10 with no higher sham false-alarm rate
evaluation.competitive_gate: Practical gate AND for every seed plastic_snn recall >= each cheap baseline that meets sham false-alarm cap1/minute
evaluation.device_gate: UNMEASURED: no physical deployment or device energy data
evaluation.cost_scope: Report model/detector processing and data preparation separately, plus full process CPU/wall; offline provenance/compression overhead identified; no chip-energy inference

stopping_rule: One frozen run and independent replay; retain negative results; no held-data tuning or replacement of x axis/recordings/parameters
